children: Bandwidth plans to use a September 2026 investor presentation highlighting AI voice orchestration, 2026 guidance and financial metrics.
Presentation for Q3 2026 investor conferences furnished as Exhibit 99.1 and posted on Bandwidth’s investor site.
Presentation emphasizes Maestro AI voice orchestration, global network in ~70 countries and positioning for AI-driven growth.
Reiterates 2026 guidance: ~20% revenue growth and ~33% Adjusted EBITDA growth with improving net leverage and free cash flow.
Highlights strong customer metrics: 99% customer name retention, 113% net retention rate, and long-tenured top customers.
Includes non-GAAP reconciliations and legal forward-looking disclaimers; company will not update the materials.
